title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.01509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. translated_abstract: 关于大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）后训练的一个新兴假设是：后训练仅仅是锐化（强化）了基模型已有的行为，以牺牲解空间覆盖率为代价来提升单次采样准确率。尽管这种权衡已在数学和编程任务中被观察到，但它未必适用于智能体任务，因为多轮工具使用与交互可能需要后训练过程中新获得的能力。我们令人惊讶的发现是：配备轻量推理框架的预训练LLM即可胜任智能体工作。尽管其准确率（pass@1）远低于后训练模型，但在足够的测试时预算下，它们在解空间覆盖率（pass@K）上往往能超过其后训练版本。我们进一步分析了背后的机制，表明后训练将任务推向两个极端——要么总能解决、要么永远无法解决——从而以牺牲解空间覆盖率为代价换取了采样效率与一致性的提升。
tldr: 该论文发现RL后训练会将模型行为“锐化”至两个极端（总能解决或永远无法解决），以牺牲解空间覆盖率为代价换取更高的单次准确率与一致性；配备轻量推理框架的预训练LLM作为智能体虽然pass@1较低，但在足够测试预算下的pass@K往往超越后训练模型。
en_tdlr: RL post-training sharpens LLM behaviors toward two extremes (always solved or never solved), trading solution coverage for higher single-shot accuracy and consistency; pre-trained LLMs with a light inference harness, despite lower pass@1, often surpass post-trained counterparts in pass@K given a sufficient test-time budget.
